title: Inner Embers
author: Elanaaga
text:
Rather than raging between armies,
it comes down heavily on plebeians.
Sows the seeds of cadavers,
and dances spitefully on the
skulls of the guileless.
This bloodthirsty demon lives
on the lives of the innocent.
Citing the stubbornness
of two sides as an excuse,
it pretends haplessness.
Thundering intermittently,
it rains savagery;
renders lives miserable.

It has neither temperance nor tiredness.
It plays the tunes of battles;
keeps on marching endlessly.
The sounds of
the collapsing buildings
are the echoes
of its accompaniments!

O unbridled steed!
Stop your sprint.
Smash not the splendour
of lives with your hooves.
Erect not a tomb to the welfare
of humans.
